name: AuditPbcRequestTracker
tagline: Prepared-by-client request lists with a client portal – issue, chase, collect evidence, review and sign off.
description: A complete PBC module for audit and accounting firms in one Power Apps code component: dashboard with fieldwork readiness by audit area, requests list with bulk reminders and due dates, status board, client portal view for uploads, detail panel with evidence, return rounds and sign-off, and a validated request form. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Chase and escalation rules with reminder log
Evidence file references with automatic Partially uploaded
Return rounds with feedback and escalation confirmation
Completion by audit area and ageing buckets
Bulk reminder, due date, assignment and status
Undo, keyboard and touch, phone layout
Power Fx outputs and six events
